influences.name: Paul McCartney
influences.context: I've been fortunate to collaborate with so many amazing artists over the years, but I think my favorite collaboration was probably with Paul McCartney. We had a great creative synergy, and I think our music together was really special.

influences.name: Lionel Richie
influences.context: I think one of my favorites was probably "We Are The World," which I co-wrote with Lionel Richie and performed with a group of incredible artists to raise money for famine relief in Africa.

influences.name: Stevie Wonder
influences.context: You've collaborated with some incredible musicians over the years, including Paul McCartney and Stevie Wonder. Do you have a favorite collaboration?
